candidates.description: This vector represents the letters of the Hebrew alphabet.
This vector activates strongly on non-Latin script characters and subword fragments from various writing systems such as Hebrew, Hindi, and Arabic.
These tokens represent common Hindi pronouns, conjunctions, and adverbial particles.
This vector activates on common Devanagari (Hindi) character combinations and syllable fragments.
This feature vector activates strongly on the Hindi character 'स' (sa) and its various vowel-modified or conjunct forms.
This feature vector activates on Hindi/Devanagari character prefixes and sub-word tokens.
This vector represents Indic script characters, phonetic symbols, and sub-word tokens primarily associated with Devanagari and related South Asian writing systems.
These tokens represent common characters, subwords, and vowel/consonant combinations frequently occurring in Devanagari script.
This feature vector represents common Hindi subword tokens and prefixes found in text corpora.
This vector represents characters, subwords, and roots belonging to the Devanagari script used for languages like Hindi and Marathi.
